children: Robert S. Keane, an insider director and CEO, Chairman, reported direct and indirect sales of Cimpress ordinary shares on September 11, 2026. The filings show six non-derivative sale transactions executed at weighted-average prices ranging from $84.61 to $86.09 per share (individual ranges disclosed in footnotes). The total proceeds from the sales were $2,376,989. Following the reported transactions, Keane directly owns 91,167 ordinary shares and indirectly owns 1,921,276 ordinary shares. The indirect holdings include shares held by Second Delaware 2003, LLC; RHS Delaware Holdings LLC (which includes shares held by Eastern Irrevocable, LLC and Western Irrevocable, LLC); Delaware 2001 Investment Trust; and Third Delaware 2011, LLC.
